item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a bar magnet, a thin cardboard sheet, and a compass. Bilal places the sheet between the magnet and the compass needle.

What should he expect?

options.A: The needle stops responding; any sheet blocks the magnet.
options.B: The needle can still turn; a thin cardboard sheet does not cut off the magnet's effect.
options.C: The needle responds only if the sheet is removed.
options.D: Cardboard stops the needle, but a clear plastic sheet of the same thickness would not.
